reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The 356.707904 m² remainder (0.3912%) was inspected against original pinned INAO/cadastral polygons in EPSG:2154. All 8 components touch the INAO boundary. The three largest components follow the diagonal southwestern boundary, the western edge of the eastern parcel block and the northwestern edge. Neither Brochon nor Morey-Saint-Denis has parcel contact or covers any uncovered area. These are boundary mismatches, with no geometry added, clipped, buffered or filled. The 356.8 m² cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this measurement; changed source hashes require another review.
